item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Our Values and Passion Have Not Lost... Will Do Our Best for the Success of the Lee Jae-myung Government" (정청래 “우리의 가치·열정은 지지 않아…이재명 정부 성공 위해 최선”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, a candidate who lost in the Democratic Party of Korea's leadership election, said on the 17th, "We lost in numbers, but our values and our passion have not lost." (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에서 패배한 정청래 후보가 17일 “우리는 숫자로 졌지만 우리의 가치와 우리의 열정은 지지 않았다”고 말했다.)

Speaking to reporters after the party convention held at the Daejeon Convention Center in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, Jung conveyed congratulations to the new party leader Kim Min-seok and made these remarks. Jung said, "Organization cannot overcome the wind. But this time, that organization must have been too strong. A sharpshooter shoots an arrow without calculating the wind. I failed to be a sharpshooter, and I am infinitely sorry to all of you (supporters)." He added, "Candidate Jung Cheong-rae lost, but the rights-bearing party members and supporters who backed him have won." <<> Jung also expressed his determination to continue the reform agenda he emphasized during the leadership race. He stated, "The path we must take—just as a river never gives up on the sea—the 'four-tong unification' (presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung) I advocated, the pan-democratic and progressive solidarity, and the banner of reform cannot be lowered for even a moment. We must raise the banner of reform even higher and move forward." <<> In a Facebook post after the convention, Jung also wrote, "I will raise the banner of popular sovereignty and party member sovereignty reform even higher. I will become the vanguard of uninterrupted reform. I will tread steadily into the hearts of the people, using the tears of my comrades as straw sandals." <<> To the new leader Kim, Jung said, "I ask that you lead the Democratic Party well. I hope you will further strengthen and safeguard the one-member-one-vote party member sovereignty system," adding, "I will consistently do my utmost for the success of the Lee Jae-myung government." <<> Choi Ha-yan Reporter chy@hani.co.kr (정 후보는 이날 대전 유성구 대전컨벤션센터에서 열린 전당대회 뒤 기자들과 만나 김민석 신임 당대표에게 축하 인사를 전하며 이렇게 말했다. 정 후보는 “조직은 바람을 이기지 못한다. 그런데 이번에는 그 조직이 너무나 셌나보다”라며 “명사수는 바람을 계산하지 않고 활을 쏜다. 제가 명사수가 되지 못해 (지지자) 여러분께 한없이 죄송하다”고 했다. 정 후보는 이어 “정청래 후보는 졌지만 정청래 후보를 지지한 권리당원과 지지자 여러분은 승리했다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party launches 'Kim Min-seok leadership'... Tasks ahead: 'resolving internal conflict, winning 2028 general election' (민주당 ‘김민석 지도부’ 출범…‘당내 갈등 해소·2028 총선 승리’ 과제로)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, the new leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, was elected on the 17th through preferential voting as the leader of the ruling party for the second term of the Lee Jae-myung administration. Starting his two-year term that day, the new leader Kim faces the weighty tasks of resolving deepening internal party conflict and leading the party to victory in the 2028 general election. (김민석 더불어민주당 신임 대표가 17일 선호투표 끝에 이재명 정부 두번째 집권 여당 대표로 선출됐다. 이날부터 2년의 임기를 시작한 김 신임 대표 앞에는 깊어진 당내 갈등을 해소하고, 2028년 총선 승리를 이끌어야 하는 막중한 과제가 놓였다.)

At the Democratic Party's 3rd regular national party convention held that day at DCC (Daejeon Convention Center) in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, Kim received 54.08% of the votes, defeating runner-up candidate Chung Cheong-rae, who received 45.92%, by a margin of 8.16 percentage points, and was elected leader of the 161-seat ruling party. This result reflects a weighted calculation of delegate and party member votes (70%), public opinion polls (30%), and strategic region (Daegu, North Gyeongsang, South Gyeongsang) weightings. Since no candidate received a majority in the first tally (first-choice vote count), a preferential voting system was applied in which the second-choice votes of voters who had cast their ballots for third-place candidate Song Young-gil were reflected in the final vote shares of Kim and Chung. At the vote of approximately 17,000 national delegates held that day, Kim received 66.69%, while in the public opinion poll he gained 49.30% support, defeating Chung, who received 33.31% and 50.70% respectively. (김 대표는 이날 대전 유성구 디시시(DCC)대전컨벤션센터에서 열린 민주당 제3차 정기전국당원대회에서 54.08%를 득표해 45.92%를 득표한 2위 정청래 후보를 8.16%포인트 차로 제치고 161석의 집권 여당 대표에 뽑혔다. 이는 대의원·권리당원 투표(70%)와 국민 여론조사(30%), 전략지역(대구·경북·경남) 가중치가 반영된 결과다. 1차 개표(1순위 표 개표)에서 과반 득표자가 나오지 않아, 3위 송영길 후보에게 투표한 유권자의 2순위 투표를 김 후보와 정 후보 최종 득표율에 반영하는 선호투표제가 적용됐다. 김 대표는 이날 진행된 약 1만7천명 전국대의원 투표에서는 66.69%를 득표했고, 국민 여론조사에서는 49.30%의 지지를 받아 각각 33.31%와 50.70%를 얻은 정 후보를 제쳤다.)

Analysts suggest that the Democratic Party's base voters' demand for a "stable party-presidency relationship" played a significant role in the party's fresh start under the "Kim Min-seok helm" in the second year of the Lee Jae-myung administration. Kim, who served as the first prime minister of the Lee Jae-myung administration, argued during the campaign period that his competitor Chung, who served as party leader over the past year, frequently clashed with the presidential office, and has emphasized that he would steer the party-presidency relationship in a stable direction going forward. (이재명 정부 집권 2년차 민주당이 ‘김민석호’로 새출발을 하게 된 데는 민주당 지지층의 ‘안정적 당청 관계’에 대한 요구가 크게 작용했다는 분석이 나온다. 이재명 정부 첫 국무총리를 지낸 김 대표는 선거 기간에 경쟁자인 정 후보가 당대표였던 지난 1년 청와대와 잦은 엇박자를 냈다고 주장하며, 향후 당청 관계를 안정적으로 끌고 가겠다고 강조해왔다.)

In his acceptance speech that day, Kim said, "The language, the policies, the attitude, the culture—all will evolve. The Democratic Party will go beyond being a historical party and a democratic party to become a party of responsibility (that takes charge of) the people's lives." He added, "The party-presidency relationship will be a 'creative horizontal relationship' of full cooperation that supports the president and the government, who are at the center of state affairs." (이날 김 대표는 당선 수락 연설에서 “언어도, 정책도, 태도도, 문화도, 진화할 것이다. 민주당은 역사 정당, 민주 정당을 넘어 국민의 삶을 (책임지는) 책임 정당이 될 것”이라며 “당청 관계는 국정의 중심인 대통령과 정부를 지원하는 전면 협력의 ‘창조적 수평 관계’가 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, among the five elected members of the Supreme Council, pro-Lee Jae-myung lawmakers Park Sun-won and Seo Mi-hwa, along with pro-Chung Cheong-rae lawmakers Choi Min-hee, Han Min-soo, and Lee Seong-yoon, were elected, forming a structure that checks the new leader Kim. (한편, 5명의 선출직 최고위원 당선자로는 친이재명계 박선원·서미화 의원과 친정청래계 최민희·한민수·이성윤 의원이 당선되며 김 대표 견제 구도가 형성됐다.)

Daejeon/Reporter Han Go-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Kyung-ju gohhani.co.kr Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (대전/고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 gohhani.co.kr 정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Trump's clear signal that he wants North Korea-US dialogue… all eyes on whether Kim Jong-un will respond (트럼프 ‘북-미 대화 원해’ 명확한 신호…김정은 호응할지 촉각)
item.description:
Just before the start of the South Korea-US joint exercise "Ulchi Freedom Shield" (UFS), US President Donald Trump ordered a "significant reduction" in the exercise and emphasized his good relations with North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un, drawing attention to whether a shift in the situation on the Korean Peninsula is in the offing. (한-미 연합훈련 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS) 시작 직전 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 훈련의 “대폭 축소”를 지시하고, 김정은 북한 국무위원장과의 좋은 관계를 강조하면서 한반도 정세에 변화가 일지 관심이 쏠린다.)

In a post on his social media platform Truth Social on the 16th (local time), President Trump said he had instructed Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to reduce the South Korea-US exercise, citing his "very good relationship" with Chairman Kim Jong-un and that North Korea has shown a "non-threatening and respectful attitude" during his presidency. The unilateral announcement of a reduction in the exercise, made on the very day the Ulchi Freedom Shield exercise began, drew criticism from the People Power Party, which said "(the US) completely bypassed South Korea." ( 트럼프 대통령은 16일(현지시각) 소셜미디어 트루스소셜에 올린 글에서 김정은 위원장과 “매우 좋은 관계”이고, 자신이 대통령으로 있는 동안 북한이 “위협적이지 않고 존중하는 태도”를 보여왔다는 이유를 들며 한-미 훈련 축소를 피트 헤그세스 국방장관에게 지시했다고 밝혔다. ‘을지 자유의 방패’ 훈련 시작 당일에 나온 일방적인 훈련 축소 발표에 국민의힘은 “(미국이) 한국을 철저히 패싱했다”고 비판을 가했다.)

In response, a senior official at the presidential office said, "South Korea and the US have closely coordinated on maintaining a firm combined defense posture and on combined exercises and training, and will continue to cooperate on specific matters related to this," adding, "We hope that the friendly relationship between the North Korean and US leaders will lead to meaningful North Korea-US dialogue, and that discussions to advance peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula will begin. We will continue to make the necessary diplomatic efforts as a facilitator." It remains uncertain whether the scale of the South Korea-US exercise will actually be adjusted. A senior official in the ruling party said, "With the exercise imminent, adjusting the scale would not be easy." ( 이에 청와대 관계자는 “한·미 양국은 확고한 연합 방위태세 유지와 연합 연습 및 훈련에 대해 긴밀히 조율해왔으며, 앞으로도 이와 관련한 구체사항에 대해 공조해나갈 것”이라며 “북·미 정상 간 우호적인 관계가 의미 있는 북-미 대화로 이어짐으로써 한반도에서 평화와 안정을 진전시키기 위한 논의가 개시되기를 바란다. 페이스메이커로서 필요한 외교적 노력을 경주해나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 실제로 한-미 훈련 규모가 조정될지는 불확실하다. 여권 고위 관계자는 “훈련이 임박해서 (규모 축소 등은) 쉽지 않을 것 같다”고 말했다.)

President Trump going beyond showcasing his "friendly relationship" with Chairman Kim Jong-un to pull out the concrete card of "reducing the South Korea-US exercise" is interpreted as a clear signal that he wants to resume North Korea-US dialogue. With the US-Iran war now in its sixth month and no exit in sight, and the November midterm elections approaching, there is also an element of trying to shift the focus to North Korea-US relations. ( 트럼프 대통령이 김정은 위원장과의 ‘우호적 관계’ 과시를 넘어 ‘한-미 훈련 축소’라는 구체적 카드를 꺼낸 것은 북-미 대화 재개를 원한다는 명확한 신호로 해석된다. 6개월째로 접어든 미국-이란 전쟁이 출구를 찾지 못하는 가운데 11월 중간선거가 다가오자 북-미 관계로 시선을 돌리려는 국면 전환용 성격도 있다.)

The key question is whether Chairman Kim Jong-un will respond. Experts believe North Korea is likely to respond if the dialogue does not discuss "denuclearization." Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, said, "Bringing up the 'reduction of the South Korea-US combined exercise' can be seen as reflecting President Trump's will to focus on resuming North Korea-US dialogue," adding, "If concrete actions such as reducing the exercise follow, there is ample possibility North Korea will accept, but it would be a dialogue aimed at showcasing friendship with Trump without discussing denuclearization." ( 관건은 김정은 위원장이 호응할지다. 전문가들은 ‘비핵화’를 논의하지 않는 대화라면 북한이 호응할 가능성은 있다고 본다. 홍민 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 “‘한-미 연합훈련 축소’를 꺼낸 것은 북-미 대화 재개에 집중하려는 트럼프 대통령의 의지가 담긴 것으로 볼 수 있다”며 “훈련 축소 등 구체적 행동이 이어지면 북한이 수용할 가능성이 충분히 있지만, 비핵화는 논의하지 않고 트럼프와의 우호를 과시하려는 대화일 것”이라고 말했다.)

Attention is also being paid to the fact that South Korea, the US, and China have begun moving closely together over the situation on the Korean Peninsula. Following President Lee Jae-myung's proposal the previous day in his Liberation Day address for "consultations among the parties concerned toward an end to the war," President Trump put forward the "exercise reduction" card, and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi is reportedly scheduled to visit South Korea this week. From late September onward, a series of meetings between South Korea and the US, South Korea and China, and the US and China are expected, including Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to the US, the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China in November, and the G20 summit in Miami, US in December. ( 특히 한국과 미국, 중국이 한반도 상황을 둘러싸고 긴밀히 움직이기 시작한 시점도 주목된다. 이재명 대통령이 전날 광복절 경축사에서 ‘종전을 향한 당사국 간 협의’를 제안한 데 이어 트럼프 대통령이 ‘훈련 축소’ 카드를 내놨고, 이번주 왕이 중국 외교부장이 방한할 것으로 알려져 있다. 9월 말부터는 시진핑 중국 국가주석의 방미, 11월 중국 선전 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의, 12월 미국 마이애미에서 열리는 주요 20개국(G20) 정상회의 등에서 한·미, 한·중, 미·중의 연쇄 만남이 이어진다.)

Kim Sung-bae, president of the Institute for National Security Strategy, said, "President Lee's proposal for 'dialogue among the parties to the Korean War' is a strategic shift that envisions first discussing a peace regime among South, North Korea, the US, and China, and in that process discussing a 'halt to North Korea's nuclear program' to prevent the advancement of its nuclear capabilities," adding, "If South Korea persuades the US and China ahead of the major diplomatic schedule in the second half of the year, the situation could shift." ( 김성배 국가안보전략연구원 원장은 “이 대통령이 내놓은 ‘종전 당사국 간 대화’ 제안은 우선 남·북·미·중이 평화체제를 논의하고 그 과정 속에서 북핵 능력의 고도화를 막는 ‘북핵 중단’을 논의할 수 있다는 전략적 전환”이라며 “하반기 주요 외교 일정을 앞두고 한국이 미, 중을 설득하면 국면이 전환될 수 있다”고 말했다.)

President Trump also pressured South Korea by claiming, "I recently asked the South Korean president whether he would join us in the denuclearization of Iran, and he said he would decline." The government dismissed this as groundless. The weight of interpretation leans toward this being an expression of dissatisfaction that South Korea has not actively deployed warships to the Strait of Hormuz and has been slow in fulfilling its investment commitments to the US. The presidential office emphasized, "The government has actively participated in international discussions for a ceasefire in Iran and the restoration of free navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, and is closely discussing practical and military contribution measures with the US side, taking into account all factors including readiness on the Korean Peninsula and domestic legal procedures." ( 트럼프 대통령은 아울러 “최근 한국 대통령에게 이란 비핵화에 우리와 함께할 의향이 있는지 물었는데, ‘사양하겠다’고 했다”고 주장하며 한국을 압박하기도 했다. 정부는 이에 사실무근이라고 밝혔다. 이는 한국이 호르무즈해협 군함 파견에 적극 나서지 않고 대미 투자 이행이 늦어지는 데 대해 불만 표출이란 쪽에 무게가 실린다. 청와대는 “정부는 이란에서의 휴전과 호르무즈해협 자유 통항 회복을 위한 국제사회의 논의에 적극 참여해왔고 한반도 대비태세와 국내법 절차 등 제반 요인을 감안해 실질적, 군사적 기여 방안을 미 측과 긴밀히 논의 중”이라고 강조했다.)

item.title: ‘Pro-Chung’ Choi Min-hee, Lee Sung-yoon, Han Min-su and ‘Pro-Myung’ Park Sun-won, Seo Mi-hwa Elected as Democratic Party Supreme Members... Check on Kim Min-seok (민주 최고위원에 ‘친청’ 최민희·이성윤·한민수 ‘친명’ 박선원·서미화…김민석 견제)
item.description:
In the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 national convention election for Supreme Council members, three pro-Chung (pro-Chung Chung-rae) candidates and two pro-Myung (pro-Lee Jae-myung) candidates were ultimately elected. With the pro-Chung faction securing a majority of the five elected Supreme Council members, observations are emerging that the leadership of new party leader Kim Min-seok may face checks going forward. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 최고위원 선거에서 친청(친정청래)계 후보 3명, 친명(친이재명)계 후보 2명이 최종 당선됐다. 선출직 최고위원 5명 가운데 친청계가 과반을 차지하면서, 향후 김민석 신임 당대표의 리더십이 견제를 받을 수 있다는 관측이 나온다.)

Soh Byung-hoon, head of the Democratic Party's election management committee, announced on the 17th at the national convention held at DCC Daejeon Convention Center in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, that candidates Choi Min-hee (18.35%), Park Sun-won (17.57%), Seo Mi-hwa (16.60%), Lee Sung-yoon (16.35%), and Han Min-su (15.86%) (in order of vote share) were elected in the final Supreme Council election. Candidate Kim Yong received 15.26% of the vote and was defeated, trailing Han Min-su by 0.6 percentage points. This election combined delegate and party member voting (70%) with a public opinion poll (30%) to calculate the final results, and was conducted using a cumulative voting method in which each voter selected two candidates. The newly elected Supreme members Choi Min-hee, Lee Sung-yoon, and Han Min-su are classified as pro-Chung, while Park Sun-won and Seo Mi-hwa are classified as pro-Myung. (소병훈 민주당 선거관리위원장은 17일 대전 유성구 디시시(DCC)대전컨벤션센터에서 열린 전당대회 최고위원 최종 선거 결과 최민희(18.35%)·박선원(17.57%)·서미화(16.60%)·이성윤(16.35%)·한민수(15.86%) 후보(득표율순)가 당선됐다고 발표했다. 김용 후보는 15.26%를 득표해 한민수 후보에게 0.6%포인트 차이로 밀려 낙선했다. 이번 선거는 대의원·권리당원 투표 70%와 국민 여론조사 30%를 합산해 최종 결과를 집계했으며, 유권자 1명이 2명을 뽑는 연기명 방식으로 치러졌다. 이번에 당선된 최민희·이성윤·한민수 최고위원은 친청계, 박선원·서미화 최고위원은 친명계로 분류된다.)

In the early stages of the nationwide regional primaries, the top five within the winning range were Choi Min-hee, Park Sun-won, Han Min-su, Seo Mi-hwa, and Kim Yong in that order, maintaining a "three pro-Myung, two pro-Chung" composition. However, in the final week, through the Honam region and Seoul-Gyeonggi primaries held on the 15th–16th, the rankings shifted dramatically. While pro-Myung candidates took the top spots in Honam and pro-Chung candidates dominated in Seoul-Gyeonggi, Kim Yong was pushed to sixth place and ultimately eliminated. (전국 순회경선 초반엔 당선권인 상위 5위에 최민희·박선원·한민수·서미화·김용 후보 순으로 ‘친명 3명, 친청 2명’ 구도가 이어졌지만, 마지막 주인 지난 15∼16일 호남권과 서울·경기 경선을 거치며 순위가 요동쳤다. 호남에서는 친명계가, 서울·경기에서는 친청계가 상위권을 차지한 가운데 김용 후보가 6위로 밀려나 최종 탈락했다.)

Throughout this election, factional tensions ran high, with strategies such as the so-called "birthday-pairing voting" shared among factions to secure three of the five elected Supreme Council seats—a majority. The day before, immediately after the party member voting results were announced, pro-Myung candidates Im Mi-ae and Kim Young-ho withdrew from the race while appealing for support for Kim Yong. As the election unfolded as an overt proxy war between factions, healing factional conflict has emerged as the top priority for the new leadership. How new leader Kim Min-seok manages his relationship with the pro-Chung Supreme Council members is expected to determine the future direction of the leadership. (이번 선거 국면에선 계파별로 선출직 최고위원 과반인 3명을 확보하기 위해 이른바 ‘생일별 짝짓기 투표’ 전략이 공유되는 등 도를 넘는 감정싸움이 이어졌다. 전날 권리당원 투표 결과 발표 직후에는 친명계 임미애·김영호 후보가 김용 후보 지지를 호소하며 후보직을 사퇴하기도 했다. 선거가 노골적인 계파 대리전 양상으로 치러진 만큼, 계파 갈등 봉합이 신임 지도부 내부의 최우선 과제로 떠올랐다. 김민석 신임 대표가 친청계 최고위원들과 관계를 어떻게 설정하느냐에 따라 향후 지도부 방향성도 결정될 것으로 보인다.)

All of the Supreme Council members elected on this day are in their 50s and 60s. Except for Choi, who is serving her second term, all are first-term lawmakers. Two of the five are women (Choi Min-hee and Seo Mi-hwa), and Seo is visually impaired. The Supreme Council, the party's highest executive body, consists of nine members: the party leader, the floor leader, five elected Supreme Council members, and two appointed Supreme Council members nominated by the party leader. (이날 뽑힌 최고위원들은 모두 50~60대다. 재선인 최 최고위원을 빼면 모두 초선 의원이다. 5명 중 2명은 여성(최민희·서미화)이고, 서 최고위원은 시각장애인이다. 민주당 최고 당무집행기관인 최고위원회는 총 9명이다. 당대표와 원내대표, 선출직 최고위원 5명, 당대표가 지명하는 지명직 최고위원 2명으로 이뤄진다.)

Daejeon/Kim Chae-un Reporter cwk@hani.co.kr (대전/김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee to hold dinner with Kim Min-seok, Jung Cheong-rae, Song Young-gil... "A gathering for party unity and party-government-presidential office cooperation" (이 대통령, 김민석·정청래·송영길과 만찬…“당내 통합·당정청 협력 자리”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung has invited Kim Min-seok, the newly elected leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, along with lawmakers Jung Cheong-rae and Song Young-gil, who were his rival candidates, to the presidential office for a dinner on the 19th. (이재명 대통령이 오는 19일 김민석 더불어민주당 신임 당대표와 경쟁 후보였던 정청래·송영길 의원을 청와대로 초청해 만찬을 하기로 했다.)

Kang Yu-jeong, senior presidential spokesperson for the presidential office, announced this in a media notice on the 17th after the Democratic Party's national convention. Spokesperson Kang explained, "This dinner was arranged to further solidify party unity and strengthen state affairs cooperation among the party, the government, and the presidential office." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 17일 민주당 전당대회 뒤 언론 공지를 내어 이렇게 밝혔다. 강 대변인은 “이번 만찬은 당의 통합과 당정청 간의 국정 협력을 더욱 공고히 하기 위해 마련됐다”고 설명했다.)

President Lee had previously emphasized party harmony in a video address at the national convention, saying, "The Democratic Party is strongest when it is one." He stated, "We have debated and competed fiercely and in a manner befitting the Democratic Party, but starting today, we must unite as one around the new leadership. We are one." This is interpreted as a remark mindful of the aftermath of a national convention that grew so heated that even the support base was split. (이 대통령은 앞서 전당대회 영상 축사에서 “민주당은 하나일 때 가장 강했다”며 당의 화합을 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “그동안 민주당답게, 또 치열하게 토론하고 경쟁했지만 오늘부터는 새로운 지도부를 중심으로 다시 하나로 똘똘 뭉쳐야 한다”며 “우리는 하나”라고 했다. 지지층까지 분열될 정도로 과열된 전당대회 후유증을 염두에 둔 발언으로 풀이된다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: First Test for Kim Min-seok's Leadership: 'Integrating a Divided Party'... "Creative Horizontal Relationship Between Party and Administration" (‘쪼개진 당심 통합’ 김민석호 첫 시험대...“당청 창조적 수평관계로”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, elected leader of the Democratic Party of Korea on the 17th, now faces formidable tasks: fostering internal party unity and supporting the second year of the Lee Jae-myung administration's governance. The Seoul mayoral by-election, which could be held as early as April next year, and the 2028 general election are high-stakes challenges for the entire opposition bloc. The "manipulated indictment special counsel" issue, which has sparked controversy over granting the power to withdraw prosecutions, also remains a ticking time bomb. (17일 당선된 김민석 더불어민주당 대표는 당내 화합과 이재명 정부 집권 2년차 국정 운영을 뒷받침해야 하는 만만찮은 숙제를 안게 됐다. 이르면 내년 4월 치러질 수 있는 서울시장 보궐선거와 2028년 총선은 여권 전체의 명운이 걸린 과제다. 공소취소 권한 부여 문제를 두고 논란이 거센 ‘조작기소 특검’ 문제도 뇌관이다.)

The most urgent task for Leader Kim is achieving internal party harmony. The August 17 national convention, marred by unprecedented overheating stemming from allegations of Shincheonji's interference in the primary and disputes over legitimacy and partisan maneuvers, left deep emotional rifts not only among candidates but also among party members. Candidates fiercely attacked each other, vowing to file complaints with the ethics committee and escalating suspicions of illegal "phone bank" campaign tactics into a barrage of accusations. Former President Moon Jae-in even expressed concern in a video address at the convention on the 17th, warning, "If things continue this way, it spells trouble," and urging that "competition must not divide the party." Within the party, voices are rising for Leader Kim to pursue a balanced appointment strategy. Seemingly aware of this, Kim said in his acceptance speech as party leader, "Jung Cheong-rae and Song Young-gil will run alongside me. I will open that stage wide and welcome them in." The fact that all three pro-Jung Cheong-rae lawmakers—Choi Min-hee, Han Min-soo, and Lee Seong-yoon—were elected to the Supreme Council and entered the leadership is both a burden for Kim and a test of his "unity leadership." Candidate Jung Cheong-rae remarked, "The moment Kim Min-seok was elected, I offered my sincere congratulations." Immediately after his election, Kim appointed Rep. Kim Tae-seon, who served as chief of staff to President Lee Jae-myung when he was party leader, as his chief of staff, and Rep. Park Seong-jun as senior spokesperson. (김 대표가 풀어야 할 가장 시급한 과제는 당내 화합이다. 8·17 전당대회는 신천지 경선 개입 의혹과 적통·파묘 논쟁 등으로 인한 이례적인 과열 탓에 후보들은 물론 당원들 사이의 감정의 골도 깊을 대로 깊어졌다. 상대를 향해 윤리위 제소를 공언하고 ‘전화방’ 불법 선거운동 의혹이 고발전으로 비화되는 등 상대를 격하게 몰아세웠다. 문재인 전 대통령도 17일 전당대회 영상 축사에서 “이대로 가면 큰일”이라며 “경쟁이 당을 분열시켜서는 안 된다”고 우려할 정도였다. 당내에서는 김 대표가 탕평 인사를 해야 한다는 목소리가 나온다. 이를 의식한 듯 김 대표도 당대표 수락 연설에서 “정청래, 송영길이 함께 뛸 것이다. 제가 그 장을 넓게 열고 함께 모시겠다”고 했다. 최민희·한민수·이성윤 의원 등 친정청래계 의원 3명이 모두 최고위원에 당선돼 지도부에 진입한 것도 김 대표로선 부담이자 ‘통합 리더십’을 시험할 대목이다. 정청래 후보는 “김민석 후보가 당선되는 순간 진심으로 축하한다는 인사말을 건넸다”고 말했다. 김 대표는 당선 직후 비서실장에 이재명 대통령이 당대표일 때 수행실장을 지낸 김태선 의원을, 수석대변인에는 박성준 의원을 임명했다.)

Boosting the approval ratings of the Lee Jae-myung administration, which are trending downward in its second year, is another major task. Various polls show President Lee's job performance approval rating has hit its lowest point since taking office, with a "dead cross" phenomenon emerging where negative assessments outnumber positive ones. Winning over the MZ generation (those in their 20s and 30s), who are markedly more indifferent to the current government compared to other age groups, is no easy challenge. According to a Gallup poll conducted from the 11th to the 13th, approval ratings for President Lee among those in their 20s and 30s stood at only 30% and 37%, respectively. Without raising support among this demographic, victory in the Seoul mayoral by-election, potentially held next April, and the 2028 general election cannot be guaranteed. During the party convention process, Kim stated, "If I become leader, I will raise the party's approval rating by 10 percentage points within 100 days of taking office," adding, "I will immediately begin preparations for the 2027 Seoul mayoral and Gangneung parliamentary by-elections and seek a vote of confidence in the party leader after those elections." (하락 추세인 집권 2년차 이재명 정부의 지지도를 견인하는 것도 주요 과제다. 각종 여론조사에서 이 대통령 국정수행 지지도는 취임 뒤 최저치를 기록하면서 부정 평가가 긍정 평가를 웃도는 ‘데드크로스’ 현상도 나타나고 있다. 다른 연령대에 견줘 확연하게 현 정부에 냉담한 2030세대의 마음을 돌리는 것도 녹록잖은 과제다. 지난 11~13일 갤럽 여론조사 결과 2030세대의 이 대통령 지지율은 각각 30%, 37%에 그쳤다. 이 세대의 지지율을 끌어올리지 못하면, 내년 4월 치러질 수 있는 서울시장 보궐선거와 2028년 총선 승리를 낙관할 수 없다. 김 대표는 전대 과정에서 “대표가 되면 취임 100일 안에 정당 지지율을 10%포인트 올릴 것”이라며 “2027년 서울시장, 강릉 국회의원 보궐선거 준비를 즉각 시작하고, 선거 이후 당대표의 재신임을 묻겠다”고 말한 바 있다.)

There is also the task of establishing a "Kim Min-seok-style" party-administration relationship. During the convention, Kim criticized the previous leadership under Jung Cheong-rae for hampering the Lee Jae-myung administration. In his acceptance speech, Kim described the party-administration relationship as a "creative horizontal relationship of cooperation that supports the president and government." In particular, whether to include the power to withdraw prosecutions in the manipulated indictment special counsel bill is likely to become a "hot potato" in the future. A senior lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area commented, "Pushing the special counsel bill with the prosecution withdrawal clause will become a legislative task staking the fate of the administration." <<>> Additionally, handling real estate and tax-related bills, which face significant negative public opinion, is expected to be another test for Kim. On the 14th, Kim wrote on X (formerly Twitter), "The real estate tax reform proposal requires discussions on refining details, premised on agreement with the broad direction." A second-term lawmaker with party leadership experience noted, "Right now, the agenda isn't being managed properly, with battle lines forming everywhere, and the presidential office appears to be driving everything," adding, "It's necessary to set priorities on pressing issues and appropriately divide roles among the party, government, and presidential office for each matter." (‘김민석식’ 당-청 관계를 어떻게 정립하느냐는 과제도 있다. 김 대표는 전대 과정에서 정청래 전 지도부가 이재명 정부의 발목을 잡았다는 취지로 공격한 바 있다. 김 대표는 당대표 수락 연설에서 당-청 관계를 “대통령·정부를 지원하는 협력의 창조적 수평 관계”라고 말했다. 특히 조작기소 특검법에 공소취소 권한을 둘지 여부는 향후 ‘뜨거운 감자’가 될 가능성이 있다. 한 수도권 다선 의원은 “공소취소 조항을 포함한 특검법 추진은 정권의 명운을 건 입법 과제가 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

The People Power Party, in a commentary by Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon, congratulated Kim on his election and urged, "Be a responsible ruling party for the people, not a shield for Lee Jae-myung." (아울러 부정 여론이 큰 부동산과 세제 관련 법안 처리 문제도 김 대표에게 시험대가 될 것으로 보인다. 김 대표는 지난 14일 엑스(X)에 “부동산 세제 개편안은 큰 방향에 공감하는 전제 위에서 디테일 보완 논의가 필요하다”고 말했다. 당직 경험이 있는 한 재선 의원은 “지금은 어젠다가 제대로 관리 안 된 상태로 도처에 전선이 형성돼 있고, 모든 사안을 청와대가 주도하는 모양새”라며 “현안 우선순위를 정리하고 사안별로 당·정·청 역할을 적절히 나눌 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (국민의힘은 박성훈 수석대변인 논평에서 김 대표의 당선을 축하하며 “이재명 방탄이 아닌 국민을 위한 책임 있는 여당이 되어달라”고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok vs. Jeong Cheong-rae in tight 'one-person-one-vote' race... Honam's choice for 'regime stability' decided the outcome (김민석-정청래 ‘1인 1표제’ 박빙…‘정권 안정론’ 호남 선택에 승부 갈렸다)
item.description:
It was the Honam region's party member sentiment, driven by "regime stability," that determined the new leader of the Democratic Party of Korea in the second year of the Lee Jae-myung administration. In the party convention held on the 17th, candidate Kim Min-seok, elected as the new leader, fought a tough battle against candidate Jeong Cheong-rae, engaging in a single-digit vote margin contest among voting party members in all 16 regions nationwide except Honam and Jeju. The evaluation is that Kim's victory reflected a combination of Honam's desire for stable governance of the Lee Jae-myung administration, aspirations for regime renewal, and expectations for the success of the three major mega-projects. (이재명 정부 임기 2년차 새 더불어민주당 대표를 결정지은 것은 ‘정권 안정론’이 관통한 호남의 당심(당원 표심)이었다. 17일 민주당 전당대회에서 신임 대표로 선출된 김민석 후보는 전국 16개 권역 중 호남·제주를 제외한 지역의 권리당원 투표에서 정청래 후보와 한자릿수 득표율 경합을 벌이며 힘든 싸움을 이어왔다. 김 대표의 승리는 호남의 이재명 정부의 안정적 국정 운영과 정권 재창출의 열망, 3대 메가프로젝트 추진 성공에 대한 기대가 복합적으로 반영됐다는 평가가 나온다.)

This party convention was the first to implement "one-person-one-vote," making it a race in which virtually everything depended on the sentiment of voting party members. In last year's convention, delegate votes were calculated to have 17 times the value of voting party member votes, but this time, the votes cast by 17,667 delegates (number of electors) and 1,527,261 voting party members were aggregated with equal value. In his acceptance speech, Kim said, "This is historic as the first choice under one-person-one-vote party sovereignty." (이번 민주당 전당대회는 ‘1인 1표’가 처음 실시되며 권리당원 표심에 사실상 모든 것이 달린 레이스였다. 지난해 전당대회에선 대의원 표가 권리당원 표의 17배의 가치를 가진 것으로 계산됐지만, 이번 전당대회에선 1만7667명(선거인 수)의 대의원과 152만7261명의 권리당원이 던지는 표가 동등한 가치로 합산됐다. 김 대표는 당대표 수락 연설에서 “1인 1표 당원 주권의 첫 선택이라 역사적”이라고 했다.)

In the delegate vote, in which a total of 14,306 participated, Kim recorded a high vote share of 66.69%. Meanwhile, the voting party member results diverged between Honam and other regions. In Honam, which accounts for 33% of all voting party members, Kim (57.54%) far outpaced Jeong (32.65%), but in the Seoul metropolitan area, which accounts for 42%, the vote margin (Kim Min-seok 46.53%, Jeong Cheong-rae 46.02%) was just 0.51 percentage points. Nationwide, excluding Honam, the gap between Kim (46.40%) and Jeong (45.59%) was only 0.81 percentage points. In effect, Honam's active support and preference votes led Kim to final victory. Kim did not exceed 50% in the first-round final vote share, so after a preference vote (redistributing the second-choice votes of the third-place candidate to the top two candidates), he won with a final vote share of 54.08%. (김 대표는 총 1만4306명이 참여한 대의원 투표에선 66.69%의 높은 득표율을 기록했다. 반면에 권리당원 투표 결과는 호남과 그 외 지역에서 엇갈렸다. 전체 권리당원에서 33%를 차지하는 호남에선 김 대표(57.54%)가 정 후보(32.65%)를 크게 따돌렸지만, 42%를 차지하는 수도권에선 득표율(김민석 46.53%, 정청래 46.02%) 차이가 0.51%포인트였다. 전국적으로도 호남을 제외하면 김 대표(46.40%)와 정 후보(45.59%)의 득표율 격차는 0.81%포인트에 불과했다. 호남의 적극적 지지와 선호투표가 김 대표를 최종 승리로 이끈 셈이다. 김 대표는 1순위 최종 득표율이 50%를 넘기지 못해 선호투표(3위 후보의 2순위 표를 1~2위 후보에게 재분배) 끝에 최종 득표율 54.08%로 승리했다.)

Regarding the election results, a multi-term lawmaker from the Honam region said, "Honam has always made strategic decisions for regime renewal." This means Honam party members went to the polls using the yardstick of who is best suited for "stable party-government relations" and "regime renewal." There is also an interpretation that President Lee Jae-myung's public endorsement, which positioned Kim early on as the "chosen candidate," had a decisive impact. (이날 선거 결과에 대해 한 호남권 다선 의원은 “호남은 언제나 정권 재창출을 위한 전략적 결정을 해왔다”고 말했다. 호남 당원들이 ‘안정적 당청 관계’와 ‘정권 재창출’에 누가 적임자인가라는 잣대로 투표에 나선 결과란 얘기다. 이재명 대통령의 공개 지지로 김 대표가 일찌감치 ‘명픽’ 후보로 자리매김한 것이 결정적 영향을 끼쳤다는 해석도 나온다.)

There are also many who pay attention to the "background" of why Kim, despite the three-part harmony of President Lee's endorsement, all-out support from incumbent lawmakers, and Honam's backing, failed to secure an outright majority in the first round. This is because in past internal Democratic Party elections, Honam public opinion tended to align with other regions such as the Seoul metropolitan area, but this time it was different. It is also notable that in the national public opinion poll, which reflects 30% of the total vote, Jeong recorded a majority vote share of 50.70% (Kim Min-seok 49.30%). (이 대통령의 지지, 현역 의원들의 전방위적 지원 사격, 호남의 지지라는 ‘3박자’ 속에서도 김 후보가 1순위 과반승을 거두지 못한 ‘배경’을 주목하는 이들도 적잖다. 과거 민주당 당내 선거에선 호남 여론이 수도권 등 다른 지역과 ‘동조화’되는 현상이 나타나곤 했지만 이번엔 달랐다는 점이 드러났기 때문이다. 전체 투표에 30%가 반영되는 국민 여론조사에서 정 후보가 50.70%(김민석 49.30%)로 과반 득표율을 기록한 것도 눈에 띈다.)

A second-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area said, "Jeong's formidable influence, backed by strong reform agendas, was also confirmed," adding, "There is a considerable Democratic Party support base that has been formed and strengthened through online communities." (한 수도권 재선 의원은 “강력한 개혁을 앞세워 싸운 정 후보의 만만치 않은 위력도 확인됐다”며 “온라인 커뮤니티를 통해 형성되고 강화되어온 민주당 지지층이 상당하다는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Trump pressures on 'Iran denuclearization participation'... Government first mentions 'military contribution review' for Hormuz (트럼프 ‘이란 비핵화 동참’ 압박에…정부 “호르무즈 군사적 기여 검토” 첫 언급)
item.description:
After U.S. President Donald Trump expressed dissatisfaction by saying "Korea declined to join efforts for Iran's denuclearization," the government said on the 17th that it is "discussing military contribution measures" regarding freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. The shift from the previously used phrase "substantive contribution" to a more specific expression of intent for "military contribution" is seen as an attempt to ease President Trump's complaints that "Korea's contribution is insufficient." (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 ‘한국이 이란 비핵화 노력 동참을 사양했다’며 불만을 드러낸 뒤 정부가 17일 호르무즈 해협 자유 항행과 관련해 “군사적 기여 방안을 논의 중”이라고 밝혔다. 기존에 사용하던 ‘실질적 기여'란 표현 대신 “군사적 기여” 의지를 더 구체화한 것은 ‘한국의 기여가 부족하다’는 트럼프 대통령의 불만을 누그러뜨리려는 의도로 풀이된다.)

A Blue House official said in response to President Trump's social media post that day, "The government has actively participated in international discussions on a ceasefire in Iran and restoring free navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, and is closely discussing substantive and military contribution measures with the U.S. side, taking into account all factors such as readiness posture on the Korean Peninsula and domestic legal procedures." This marks the first time a government official has formally stated that "military contribution" measures are being reviewed regarding the Strait of Hormuz situation. (청와대 관계자는 이날 트럼프 대통령이 소셜미디어에서 올린 글에 대해 “정부는 이란에서의 휴전과 호르무즈 해협 자유 통항 회복을 위한 국제사회의 논의에 적극 참여해 왔고, 한반도 대비 태세와 국내법 절차 등 제반 요인을 감안해 실질적, 군사적 기여 방안을 미국 측과 긴밀히 논의 중”이라고 밝혔다. 정부 당국자가 공식적으로 “호르무즈 해협 상황에 대해 ‘군사적 기여'를 검토하고 있다”고 표현한 것은 처음이다.)

The Blue House's stance is a reaction to President Trump's claim that "I asked Korea's President (Lee Jae-myung) whether they would be willing to join efforts for Iran's denuclearization, but they said, 'No thanks!'" Although it is unclear what exactly Trump meant by "joining Iran's denuclearization efforts," the remarks were interpreted as expressing frustration that the Korean government is not moving in line with U.S. intentions regarding military contributions for stability in the Strait of Hormuz, which Washington has consistently requested from Seoul. (청와대의 이런 입장은 트럼프 대통령이 “한국의 (이재명) 대통령에게 이란의 비핵화 노력에 동참할 의향이 있는지 물었으나, 그들은 ‘사양하겠다!’(No thanks!)고 말했다”고 주장한 것에 대한 반응이다. 트럼프 대통령이 언급한 ‘이란 비핵화 노력 동참’이 구체적으로 무얼 의미하는지는 명확지 않지만, 미국이 한국에 꾸준히 요구해온 호르무즈 해협 안정을 위한 군사적 기여에 한국 정부가 미국의 의도대로 움직이지 않는다는 불만을 드러낸 것이란 해석이 나왔다.)

The government had maintained the phrase "substantive contribution" since President Lee stated at a video conference on the "Freedom of Navigation Initiative for the Strait of Hormuz" attended by leaders of about 50 countries on April 17, "We will make substantive contributions to guarantee freedom of navigation." A government official explained that "substantive contribution" is a concept encompassing diplomatic, military, and humanitarian contributions, and rather than referring to any specific measure, it was an expression keeping various options open. Regarding military contributions such as warships or patrol aircraft, the government had responded cautiously due to risks such as the safety of South Korean troops, concerns over involvement in a war with Iran, and diplomatic friction. In fact, President Trump had repeatedly requested that Korea dispatch warships, but the government had avoided publicly mentioning military contributions, instead saying it would "review substantive contributions." (정부는 지난 4월17일 이 대통령이 50여개국 정상이 참석한 ‘호르무즈 해협 해상 항행의 자유 이니셔티브' 화상 회의에서 “항행 자유 보장을 위해 실질적인 기여를 하겠다”고 발언한 이후 줄곧 ‘실질적 기여’라는 표현을 고수해왔다. ‘실질적 기여’는 외교적·군사적·인도적 기여를 총망라할 수 있는 개념으로, 특정 조처를 염두에 둔 것이 아니라 다양한 옵션을 열어둔 표현이라고 정부 당국자는 설명했다. 군함이나 초계기 등 군사적 기여의 경우 한국군 장병 안전이나 이란전 개입 논란, 외교적 마찰 등 위험성 때문에 정부는 신중하게 반응해 왔다. 실제로 트럼프 대통령은 여러 차례 한국에 군함 파병을 요청해왔지만, 정부는 “실질적 기여를 검토하겠다”는 표현으로 대신하며 군사적 기여에 대해선 공개적으로 언급하지 않았다.)

However, the background behind the Blue House's specification of the contribution method as "military contribution measures" that day appears to be the result of deliberation on how to respond to President Trump's remarks voicing complaints against Korea on multiple fronts, including the cost of South Korea-U.S. joint exercises and contributions to the Iran situation. In a post on the day the South Korea-U.S. Ulji Freedom Shield (UFS) joint exercise began, President Trump mentioned his good relationship with North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un and the costs of the joint exercise, saying, "I have ordered Secretary (of Defense) Hegseth to drastically reduce the scale of the joint exercise." By using the card of reducing the South Korea-U.S. joint exercise, which North Korea has strongly opposed, he extended an "invitation" for dialogue to the North while exerting strong pressure on allied South Korea. (하지만 이날 청와대가 ‘군사적 기여 방안’이란 표현으로 기여 방식을 구체화한 배경에는 한-미 연합훈련 비용과 이란전 기여 등 여러 측면에서 한국에 불만을 쏟아낸 트럼프 대통령 언급에 대한 대응을 고심한 결과로 보인다. 트럼프 대통령은 한·미의 을지 자유의 방패(UFS) 연합 훈련이 시작되는 당일 올린 글에서 김정은 북한 국무위원장과의 좋은 관계, 연합훈련에 드는 비용 등을 거론하면서, “헤그세스 (미 국방부) 장관에게 연합연습 규모를 대폭 축소하라고 지시했다”고 밝혔다. 북한이 강하게 반발해온 한-미 연합훈련 축소 카드로 북한에는 대화의 ‘초청장’을 내밀면서, 동맹인 한국을 강하게 압박한 것이다.)

There are interpretations that as President Trump unilaterally brought up a "drastic reduction of the joint exercise," claiming that allied South Korea is not properly sharing costs in the joint exercise and lacks contributions to the Middle East situation, the government emphasized its willingness to contribute through the phrase "military contribution" in the Strait of Hormuz. However, the Blue House official said that while discussing military contribution measures with the U.S. side, the review would proceed "taking into account all factors such as readiness posture on the Korean Peninsula and domestic legal procedures." This reflects the judgment that overseas troop dispatches require approval of a dispatch motion by the National Assembly, and that preconditions such as stabilization of the Hormuz region, including an end to the wartime situation, are necessary. (트럼프 대통령이 동맹국인 한국이 연합훈련에서 비용 분담을 제대로 하지 않고 있고, 중동사태에서도 기여가 부족하다며 일방적으로 ‘연합연습 대폭 축소’를 거론하자, 정부가 호르무즈 해협 ‘군사적 기여’라는 표현으로 기여 의지를 강조했다는 해석이 나온다. 다만 청와대 관계자는 이날 군사적 기여 방안을 미국 쪽과 논의 중이라면서도 “한반도 대비 태세와 국내법 절차 등 제반 요인을 감안해” 검토하겠다고 밝혔다. 해외파병을 위해선 국회로부터 파병동의안을 의결 받아야 하며, 호르무즈 해협에서 전쟁 상황이 종식되는 안정화 등 선제조건이 필요하다는 판단이 담겨 있다.)

Military authorities are also reportedly reviewing a list of military assets that could be deployed in consultation with the U.S. side. Maritime patrol aircraft, logistics support ships, and mine detection equipment are being mentioned. (군 당국은 미국 쪽과 협의 하에 투입 가능한 군 자산 리스트도 검토 중인 것으로 전해졌다. 해상초계기, 군수지원함, 기뢰탐지장비 등이 거론된다.)

Although President Trump mentioned "instruction to drastically reduce South Korea-U.S. joint exercises," military authorities said that no request to reduce the exercise has been received from the U.S. side regarding the Ulji Freedom Shield exercise that began that day, and the joint exercise is proceeding normally. (트럼프 대통령이 ‘한-미 연합훈련 대폭 축소 지시’를 언급했지만, 이날 시작된 을지 자유의 방패 훈련에 대해 아직 미국 쪽으로부터 훈련 축소 요구가 온 것은 없으며, 연합연습은 정상적으로 진행 중이라고 군 당국은 밝혔다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Embracing Kang Hoon-sik and clicking… Kim Min-seok "One team without walls with the Blue House" (강훈식 껴안고 찰칵…김민석 “청와대와 벽 없는 원팀”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok, the new leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, met with Kang Hoon-sik, the presidential chief of staff, on the 18th and emphasized the "one team" stance between the party and the presidential office, saying, "We will firmly support the government and the President's policy direction going forward." (김민석 더불어민주당 신임 대표가 18일 강훈식 대통령 비서실장을 만나 “앞으로 정부와 대통령님의 국정 방향을 잘 뒷받침하겠다”며 당청 ‘원팀 기조’를 부각했다.)

At a meeting with Kang and others at the National Assembly that day, Kim said, "I have a feeling, expectation, and sense of responsibility that (the party and government) will achieve completion and communication as one team without walls." Kim added, "The party will spread its tentacles into people's livelihoods, travel across the country from dawn, listen to voices from the field, deliver public sentiment to the Blue House and the government, engage in discussion, and ensure that party-government relations and state affairs run stably." (김 대표는 이날 국회에서 강 실장 등을 접견하고 “(당과 정부가) 벽이 없는 원팀으로서의 완성과 소통이 이루어지겠다는 느낌과 기대와 책임감을 갖게 됐다”라며 이렇게 말했다. 김 대표는 또 “당은 민생에 촉수를 펼치고 새벽부터 전국을 돌면서 민생 현장의 목소리를 담아서 민심을 청와대나 정부에 전달도 하고 토론도 하며 당정과 국정이 안정적으로 갈 수 있게 하겠다”라고 덧붙였다.)

Furthermore, Kim said, "In my first thank-you speech after becoming party leader yesterday, I said the party would pursue an ABC plan. It's Affordability—putting people's livelihoods first, Broadening—expansion policies, and Competence—the competency that our President has raised. But since Security, which the President also emphasized, is important, if you combine ABC with S and rearrange the order, it becomes Cabs, a taxi." He added, "I thought that going forward, the Democratic Party would become a 'livelihood taxi' racing from dawn with speed." (아울러 김 대표는 “어제 당 대표가 되고 나서 첫 감사 인사에서 앞으로 당이 에이비시(ABC) 플랜을 하겠다고 말씀드렸다. 어포더빌리티(Affordability) 민생 우선, 브로드닝(Broadening) 확장 정책, 컴피턴스(Competence), 우리 대통령님이 제기한 유능함 3가지인데, 역시 대통령께서 강조한 시큐리티(Security), 안전이 중요해서 에이비시하고 에스를 합치고 순서를 바꾸면 캡스(Cabs), 택시가 된다”며 “앞으로 민주당은 속도감 있게 새벽부터 달리는 ‘민생 택시’가 되겠다고 생각했다”라고 했다.)

In response, Kang said, "It was customary for the senior presidential secretary for political affairs to deliver a congratulatory orchid arrangement when a party leader was elected, but under the previous leader and now with the new leader, the chief of staff has come to offer congratulations," adding, "That's because we recognize how crucial it is for the party and the presidential office, and the party and the government, to work as one team." He also said, "Now I expect you to lead the Democratic Party well as one," and "With fierce competition and energy, I expect the party to become a solid unity around Leader Kim." After their remarks, the two posed for a hug in front of reporters at the suggestion of Kim Tae-sun, the party leader's chief of staff. (이에 강 실장은 “원래 당 대표가 당선되면 정무수석이 난을 주는 게 관례였는데, 전임 당 대표 때도, 지금 신임 당 대표도 비서실장이 와서 축하 난을 드리고 있다”며 “그만큼 당청이, 당과 정부가 원팀으로 뛰는 역할이 매우 중요하다고 인식하고 있기 때문”이라고 말했다. 그는 또 “이제 모두 하나가 돼 민주당을 잘 이끌어주실 것으로 기대한다”며 “뜨거운 경쟁과 에너지로, 김 대표를 중심으로 민주당은 단단한 하나가 될 것으로 기대한다”고 했다. 두 사람은 인사말이 끝난 뒤 김태선 당 대표 비서실장의 제안으로 취재진 앞에서 포옹하는 모습을 연출하기도 했다.)

After the closed-door meeting, Park Sung-joon, the Democratic Party's senior spokesman, said of Kang's visit alongside Hong Ik-pyo, the senior presidential secretary for political affairs, and Jung Eul-ho, a presidential secretary for political affairs, that it "carries great significance" and "I see today's hugs among Leader Kim, Chief of Staff Kang, Senior Secretary Hong, and Secretary Jung as the first step toward becoming one team." When asked by reporters about the possibility of bipartisan cooperation, such as courtesy visits to the opposition, he replied, "When Leader Kim talks about ABC, mentioning people's livelihoods, expansion, additive politics, and competence, it all implicitly contains the commitment to expansion politics and additive politics." (박성준 민주당 수석대변인은 이날 비공개 환담을 마치고 홍익표 청와대 정무수석, 정을호 정무비서관과 함께 강 실장이 접견을 온 것과 관련 “큰 의미가 있다”며 “오늘 김 대표가 강 실장, 홍 수석, 정 비서관과 포옹하며 원팀을 이루는 첫발을 뗐다고 본다”라고 말했다. 야당 예방 등 협치 가능성을 묻는 기자 물음에는 “김 대표가 에이비시를 이야기하면서 민생, 확장과 덧셈 정치, 유능함을 이야기하는 차원에서 볼 때 확장 정치, 덧셈 정치를 하겠다는 함축적 의미가 다 포함돼 있다”라고 답했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Carrying on Kim Dae-jung's Legacy, Will Lead AI Revolution and Energy Transition" (이 대통령 “김대중 뜻 이어받아 AI 혁명·에너지 전환 주도할 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 18th, "I will always carry in my heart the great milestone that is Kim Dae-jung, and no matter what trials I face, I will move forward without hesitation." (이재명 대통령이 18일 “김대중이라는 위대한 이정표를 항상 가슴에 품고, 어떠한 시련을 마주하더라도 주저함 없이 나아가겠다”고 말했다.)

The President made these remarks in a memorial address read on his behalf by Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik at the ceremony marking the 17th anniversary of former President Kim Dae-jung's passing, held at Seoul National Cemetery in Dongjak-gu. (이 대통령은 이날 서울 동작구 현충원에서 열린 김대중 전 대통령 서거 17주기 추모식에서 강훈식 대통령비서실장이 대독한 추모사를 통해 이렇게 밝혔다.)

The President reflected, "The fiercer the trials, the more I recall the brilliant insight and footsteps of the President, who carved a path of hope even amid despair." He added, "Even when the nation stood at the edge of a cliff, the President was a pioneer who looked far into the future." He continued, "Even while rallying a nation in crisis, he built high-speed information and communication networks across the country, laying the foundation for a knowledge-information powerhouse, and with the firm principle of 'support without interference,' he cultivated the soil for cultural projects and planted the seeds of K-culture that the world now watches." He stated, "The President's insight and pioneering spirit, which overcame crises while simultaneously preparing for the future, are the clearest milestones showing the direction the Republic of Korea should take." He further emphasized, "The people's sovereignty government will carry on that legacy and lead the great waves of the AI revolution and energy transition." (이 대통령은 “시련이 거셀수록, 절망 속에서도 희망의 길을 일궈내셨던 대통령님의 빛나는 혜안과 발자취를 되새긴다”며 “대통령님께서는 국가가 벼랑 끝에 섰을 때조차 일찌감치 먼 미래를 내다보신 선구자셨다”고 돌아봤다. 이어 “국난에 처한 나라를 일으키는 중에도 전국에 초고속 정보통신망을 구축하여 지식정보화 강국의 기틀을 만드셨고, ‘지원하되 간섭하지 않는다’는 확고한 원칙으로 문화사업의 토양을 일구어 세계가 주목하는 케이(K)-컬처의 씨앗을 심으셨다”며 “위기를 극복하는 동시에 미래를 준비하신 대통령님의 혜안과 개척자 정신은 대한민국이 나아갈 방향을 알려주는 가장 뚜렷한 이정표”라고 했다. 그러면서 “국민주권정부는 그 뜻을 이어받아 인공지능 혁명과 에너지 전환이라는 거대한 물결을 주도해 나갈 것”이라고 강조했다.)

The President also said, "I will continue the President's philosophy of warmly embracing the lives of the people." He noted, "Even in times of extreme fiscal hardship, he enacted the National Basic Livelihood Security System and declared that 'welfare is not charity but a right of the people and a productive investment.' I will reflect on that profound meaning," and added, "I will never forget, even for a moment, that it is the government's duty to clear away the deep shadows of polarization, firmly build a social safety net that reliably supports the lives of all citizens, and ensure that the fruits of growth are shared fairly across the entire nation." (이 대통령은 “국민의 삶을 따뜻하게 보듬었던 대통령님의 철학도 이어가겠다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “국가 재정이 극도로 어렵던 시절에도 국민기초생활보장제도를 제정하시며 ‘복지는 시혜가 아니라 국민의 권리이자 생산적 투자’임을 선언하셨던 그 깊은 뜻을 되새기겠다”며 “짙게 드리운 양극화의 그늘을 걷어내고, 모든 국민의 삶을 든든하게 받쳐주는 사회적 안전매트리스를 단단히 구축하며, 성장의 결실이 온 국민에게 골고루 돌아가도록 하는 것이 정부가 해야 할 일임을 한시도 잊지 않겠다”고 했다.)

Furthermore, the President added, "With growth that drives advancement and inclusion that shares warmth as the two pillars, I will create tangible changes in the lives of each and every citizen." He concluded, "I will fulfill my responsibility in state affairs through action rather than words, and through results rather than slogans, steadfastly protecting the daily lives of the people and opening the nation's future." (아울러 이 대통령은 “도약을 이끄는 성장과 온기를 나누는 포용을 두 축으로 삼아, 국민 한분 한분의 삶에 실질적인 변화를 만들어 내겠다”며 “말보다 실천으로, 구호보다 성과로 국정의 책임을 다하면서 국민의 일상을 든든히 지키고 나라의 미래를 열겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Shim Woo-sam Reporter wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Ji-won on Jung Cheong-rae's 'live broadcast after defeat': "You must accept the outcome, you shouldn't add a tail" (정청래 ‘패배 뒤 라방’에 박지원 “승복해야, 꼬리 달면 안 돼”)
item.description:
Regarding former Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae saying after losing the party's August 17 national convention leadership race, "Candidate Kim Min-seok won, but many of his arguments lost," Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won criticized it as "adding a tail," saying, "It was not desirable for former leader Jung's political future." <<> On the 18th, Park appeared on MBC Radio's "Kim Jong-bae's Focus" and, when asked by the host for his thoughts on the convention, said, "It went well," adding, "In effect, this convention was a vote of confidence in President Lee Jae-myung's first year in office. I see it as President Lee's victory." <<> At the party's 3rd regular national convention held the previous day at DCC Daejeon Convention Center in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, candidate Kim Min-seok won 54.08% of the vote, defeating second-place candidate Jung Cheong-rae, who garnered 45.92%, by an 8.16-percentage-point margin, and was elected leader of the 161-seat ruling party. After the convention, former leader Jung said in a YouTube live broadcast, "Jung Cheong-rae lost, but what Jung Cheong-rae advocated did not lose," and added, "In contrast, candidate Kim Min-seok won, but many of his arguments lost." He also said, "(Representative Kim) said the essence of this convention was breaking the secret three-way alliance of anti-Myung forces, divisionists, and Shincheonji, but that was a loss." <<> In response, Park said, "Former leader Jung adding that tail was not desirable for his political future either." When the host asked whether he saw it as a kind of lingering bitterness, Park replied, "Cleanly accepting the outcome is the greater democracy. Did former leader Jung really need to say that? It's better not to do that." <<> Jeon Gwang-jun Reporter light@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에서 패배한 뒤 정청래 전 민주당 대표가 “김민석 후보는 이겼지만, 그의 주장은 진 것이 많다”고 말한 것을 두고 박지원 민주당 의원이 “꼬리를 단 것”이라며 “정 전 대표 정치 미래를 위해서 바람직하지 않았다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Pursue Wartime Operational Control Transfer Within Term Without Delay... Accelerate Nuclear Submarine Program" (이 대통령 “전작권 임기 내 환수 차질 없이 추진…핵 잠수함 속도 내야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 18th, "We must pursue the completion of the wartime operational control transition within my term without delay, in accordance with the initial government plan." (이재명 대통령이 18일 “전시작전통제권의 임기 내 완수를 당초 정부 계획에 따라 차질 없이 추진해 나가야겠다”고 말했다.)

At an Ulchi Cabinet meeting held at Cheong Wa Dae that day, President Lee stated, "South Korea is currently rated as the world's fifth-largest military power," adding, "Our defense industry capabilities are also assessed as one of the global top four, and in particular, South Korea's defense spending level amounts to 1.4 times North Korea's gross national product." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 을지국무회의에서 “현재 대한민국은 세계 군사력 5위로 평가된다”며 “또 방산 역량은 글로벌 4강으로 평가되기도 하고, 특히 대한민국의 국방비 지출 수준은 북한의 국민총생산의 1.4배에 이른다”며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee continued, "In terms of weapons systems and force size, our capacity to defend ourselves already ranks among the top globally. It would not be an exaggeration to say it is more than sufficient." He added, "To further solidify this defense capability, it is essential to comprehensively advance operational capabilities in all domains and to establish a system for nurturing the talent to achieve this together." The government aims to complete the wartime operational control transition by 2028. (이 대통령은 이어 “무기 체계와 전력 규모 측면에서 보면 이미 우리 스스로를 지킬 역량이 전 세계적으로 몇 번째 안에 들 정도다. 차고 넘친다고 해도 과언이 아닐 정도”라며 “이러한 국방력을 좀 더 굳건하게 만들려면 작전 능력의 전방위적인 고도화, 이를 함께 이뤄낼 인재 육성 체계를 갖추는 것이 필수”라고 말했다. 정부는 2028년까지 전작권 전환을 목표로 하고 있다.)

Furthermore, President Lee instructed, "Please proceed with the preparations for the establishment of the ROK Armed Forces Academy without wavering." He also said, "I ask that we accelerate the nuclear submarine project, which will symbolize the future of a constructive and robust ROK-U.S. alliance." (아울러 이 대통령은 “국군사관학교 창설 준비 또한 흔들림 없이 진행해 주기 바란다”고 주문했다. 또 “건설적이고 굳건한 한미 동맹의 미래를 상징할 핵 잠수함 사업 추진에도 속도를 내주길 바란다”고 했다.)

Prior to the cabinet meeting, President Lee presided over a full session of the Ulchi National Security Council (NSC) to review the nation's total war-fighting capabilities, agency-specific wartime transition procedures, and response measures in preparation for wartime scenarios. Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jung said in a written briefing that day: "President Lee emphasized that creating a peace in which there is no need to fight is of utmost importance, but since we must also prepare for the worst-case scenario, he requested that the Ulchi exercises be conducted as practical drills to protect our people and ensure national security in emergencies." She added, "The Ulchi exercises are defensive in nature, aimed at safeguarding the lives and safety of our people, and through them we clearly affirmed that we have no intention of attacking North Korea or raising tensions on the Korean Peninsula." Additionally, President Lee stressed that the fundamental purpose of the Ulchi exercises is not to target any specific adversary but to protect the safe and peaceful daily lives of our citizens. (이 대통령은 국무회의에 앞서 을지 국가안전보장회의(NSC) 전체회의를 주재해 전시 상황에 대비해 국가 총력전 수행 능력과 기관별 전시 전환 절차, 조치 사항 등을 점검했다. 강유정 수석대변인은 이날 서면브리핑을 통해 “이 대통령은 싸울 필요가 없는 평화를 만드는 것이 무엇보다 중요하나 최악의 상황도 대비가 필요한 만큼, 비상사태에 우리 국민을 보호하고 국가안전보장을 위한 실질적인 연습이 되도록 을지연습을 진행해 줄 것을 당부했다”며 “그리고 을지연습은 우리 국민의 생명과 안전을 지키는 방어적 성격으로, 우리는 이를 통해 북한을 공격하거나 한반도의 긴장을 높이려는 의도가 없음을 분명히 했다”고 밝혔다. 아울러 이 대통령은 을지연습의 기본적 목적은 특정 대상을 적대시하는 것이 아니라 우리 국민들의 안전하고 평화로운 일상을 지키는 데 있음을 강조했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Instead of Harmful Political Strife, Time to Join Hands for an Irreplaceable Republic of Korea" (이 대통령 “백해무익 정쟁 대신 대체불가 대한민국 위해 손 잡을 때”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 18th, "Rather than engaging in utterly harmful political strife that turns a blind eye to the people's lives and treats each other as adversaries, it is time to join hands together to build an irreplaceable Republic of Korea." (이재명 대통령이 18일 “국민의 삶을 외면하고 서로를 적대시하는 백해무익한 정쟁보다는 대체불가 대한민국을 만들기 위해 다 함께 손을 맞잡을 때”라고 말했다.)

At a Ulchi State Council meeting he presided over at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae that day, President Lee said, "Even if we belong to different parties, different camps, or were fierce rivals in competition, as partners who share a common responsibility for the people and the nation, that responsibility is no different," adding, "We are people who bear a joint responsibility to keep moving forward together toward the future, hand in hand." His remarks draw attention as they came a day after Kim Min-seok was elected as the new leader at the Democratic Party of Korea's national convention. With internal divisions deepening over allegations of Shincheonji's interference in the primary process and disputes over political legitimacy and "grave-digging" during the convention, unifying the party has been cited as the top priority for the new leadership. <<> Seemingly mindful of this, President Lee said, "Commonality and difference coexist among people. There are things that are alike and things that are different. If you start looking for differences, divisions keep multiplying. But if you start looking for commonalities, you keep growing closer." He continued, "I urge the entire political sphere, which exercises the people's rights on their behalf, to cooperate closely to improve the people's lives, to pursue relentless reform against injustice and abnormality, and to achieve the realization of a global super-gap powerhouse." <<> President Lee also stressed, "Neither ironclad national security, nor flawless disaster preparedness, nor sustained economic growth can be achieved easily unless we unite the people's hearts. To that end, we must listen to the voices of the sovereign people, focus on the greater common ground rather than minor differences, and make steady efforts to honor the public will." He added, "People's opinions may differ, and there may be conflicts. item.title: Taereung Golf Course and Gwacheon Racecourse Get 'Green Belt Regulation Exemptions,' Passed by Cabinet (태릉골프장·과천경마장 ‘그린벨트 규제 예외’, 국무회의 통과)
item.description:
A motion to exempt public housing district development sites announced by the government from the total cap on lifting Green Belt development restrictions was passed at a Cabinet meeting. (정부가 발표한 공공주택지구 조성사업 부지를 개발제한구역(그린벨트) 해제 총량 규제에서 예외로 하는 내용의 안건이 국무회의를 통과했다.)

The government reviewed and approved five general motions, including the 'Selection of Public Housing District Development Projects for Exemption from the Total Green Belt Lifting Cap,' along with 32 presidential decrees and one bill, at the Eulji Cabinet meeting presided over by President Lee Jae-myung on the 18th. Previously, the government or local governments had to go through complex procedures to lift Green Belt restrictions beyond the statutory ceiling, but the core of this measure is granting exceptions for Green Belt sites designated as housing supply locations under the January 29 real estate package. This is a step aimed at accelerating the start of housing construction in the Taereung Golf Course and Gwacheon Racecourse areas, which include Green Belt land. (정부는 18일 이재명 대통령 주재로 열린 을지 국무회의에서 이러한 내용의 ‘개발제한구역 해제 총량 예외인정을 위한 공공주택지구 조성사업 선정안’ 등 일반 안건 5건과 대통령령안 32건, 법률안 1건 등을 심의·의결했다. 정부나 지자체가 법정 상한선을 넘어 그린벨트를 초과 해제하려면 복잡한 절차를 거쳐야 하는데, 1·29 부동산 대책에서 주택 공급지로 지정된 그린벨트 부지는 예외를 인정하는 게 뼈대다. 그린벨트 부지를 포함하고 있는 태릉골프장, 과천경마장 일대 주택 착공 속도를 높이기 위한 조처다.)

At the Cabinet meeting, enforcement decrees related to the Serious Crime Investigation Office, which is set to open in October, were also approved. The draft enforcement decree of the Act on the Organization and Operation of the Serious Crime Investigation Office includes provisions on △the composition and operation of the candidate recommendation committee for the head of the office △the scope of crimes that other investigative agencies must immediately report to the head of the office △procedures for requesting and conducting investigation reviews. Motions stipulating the organization, scope of duties, personnel, and operations of the office were also approved. Additionally, a partial amendment to the enforcement decree of the Special Act on Jeju April 3 Incident, extending the reporting period for victims and bereaved families to claim healing and compensation—which expired on June 30, 2023—to February 1 through July 31, 2027, also passed the Cabinet threshold that day. (이날 국무회의에서는 10월 개청을 앞둔 중대범죄수사청 관련 시행령들도 의결됐다. 중대범죄수사청 조직 및 운영에 관한 법률 시행령안에는 △중수청장후보추천위의 구성 및 운영에 관한 사항 △다른 수사기관이 중수청장에게 즉시 통보해야 하는 범죄 범위 △수사심의 신청 및 심의에 필요한 절차 등에 대한 내용이 담겼다. 중수청의 조직·직무 범위 및 인사와 운영에 관한 사항을 규정하는 안건들도 함께 의결됐다. 2023년 6월30일자로 만료된 제주 4·3 사건 희생자 및 유족의 피해 치유 및 보상 신고 기간을 2027년 2월1일∼7월31일까지 연장하는 제주 4·3 특별법 시행령 일부개정령안도 이날 국무회의 문턱을 넘었다.)

item.title: [Photo] 17th Anniversary of Former President Kim Dae-jung's Passing… Rival Parties Unite in "Carrying On the DJ Spirit" ([포토] 김대중 전 대통령 서거 17주기…여야 “DJ 정신 계승” 한목소리)
item.description:
Marking the 17th anniversary of former President Kim Dae-jung's passing, the political sphere spoke with one voice in vowing to "carry on the Kim Dae-jung spirit." (김대중 전 대통령 서거 17주기 추모식을 맞이해 정치권이 한 목소리로 ‘김대중 정신 계승’을 다짐했다.)

At a memorial ceremony held on the morning of the 17th at the Memorial Hall of Seoul National Cemetery in Dongjak-gu, Seoul, President Lee Jae-myung, in a eulogy read on his behalf by Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, said, "The President's keen insight and pioneering spirit—overcoming crises while preparing for the future—serve as the clearest signpost guiding the direction of the Republic of Korea," adding, "I will always keep the great signpost of Kim Dae-jung in my heart and move forward without hesitation no matter what trials we face." (이재명 대통령은 17일 오전 서울 동작구 국립서울현충원 현충관에서 열린 추모식에서 강훈식 비서실장의 대리 낭독 추모사를 통해 “위기를 극복하는 동시에 미래를 준비하신 대통령님의 혜안과 개척자 정신은 대한민국이 나아갈 방향을 알려주는 가장 뚜렷한 이정표”라며 “김대중이라는 위대한 이정표를 항상 가슴에 품고 어떠한 시련을 마주하더라도 주저함 없이 나아가겠다”고 전했다.)

Kim Min-seok, the newly inaugurated leader of the Democratic Party of Korea the previous day, also expressed his love and respect for the late president, saying, "To the forces of democracy, autonomy, progress, and reform, the President was a mountain and a sea, a reservoir and a spring. Together with the people, we will honor and learn from him in a bipartisan manner, transcending ideology." (전날 취임한 김민석 신임 더불어민주당 대표도 “대통령님께선 민주·자주·진보·개혁 세력에게 산이고 바다고, 저수지고 샘물이셨다. 국민과 함께 이념을 넘어 초당적으로 기리고 배우겠다”라며 김 전 대통령에 대한 사랑과 존경을 표했다.)

The People Power Party, which had planned to attend the memorial ceremony but diverted its course to Geoje, South Gyeongsang Province, where heavy rain damage was severe, paid tribute to the late president through a written statement that day. Park Chung-kwon, the People Power Party's senior spokesperson, said, "The People Power Party will strive to ensure that the legacy of democracy left by former President Kim Dae-jung does not end up being consumed as a slogan in partisan strife, but continues as a principle of South Korean politics." (당초 추모식에 참석하려다 폭우 피해가 심한 경남 거제 지역으로 발을 돌린 국민의힘은 이날 서면 논평으로 김 전 대통령을 추모했다. 박충권 국민의힘 수석대변인은 “국민의힘은 김대중 전 대통령께서 남긴 민주주의의 유산이 정쟁의 구호로 소비되는 데 그치지 않고, 대한민국 정치의 원칙으로 이어질 수 있도록 노력할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Kim Hye-yoon Reporter unique@hani.co.kr (김혜윤 기자 unique@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee to Meet Wang Yi on the 20th... Discussions on Korea-China Relations and Korean Peninsula Situation (이 대통령, 20일 왕이 접견…한중 관계·한반도 정세 논의)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung is scheduled to meet with Wang Yi, China's Foreign Minister and Director of the CCP Central Foreign Affairs Commission Office, on the 20th. (이재명 대통령이 오는 20일 왕이 중국 외교부장 겸 공산당 중앙외사판공실 주임을 접견할 예정이다.)

The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae stated on the 18th, "President Lee will meet with Minister Wang, who is making an official visit to Korea from the 19th to the 20th, at Cheong Wa Dae on the morning of the 20th," adding, "President Lee will assess the direction of Korea-China relations and the regional situation, and will convey his regards to Chinese President Xi Jinping." (청와대는 18일 “이 대통령이 19일부터 20일까지 한국을 공식 방문하는 왕 부장을 20일 오전 청와대에서 접견한다”며 “이 대통령은 한-중 관계 발전 방향 및 역내 정세 등에 대해 평가하고 시진핑 중국 국가주석에게 안부를 전할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

In addition, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac will hold talks and a luncheon with Minister Wang on the same day. The meeting is expected to involve a broad exchange of views on mutual interests, including Korea-China relations, the situation on the Korean Peninsula, and regional and international issues. (아울러 위성락 국가안보실장도 같은 날 왕 부장과 회담 및 오찬을 할 예정이다. 이 자리에서는 한-중 관계, 한반도 정세를 비롯한 지역 및 국제문제 등 상호 관심사에 대한 폭넓은 의견 교환이 이뤄질 전망이다.)

In particular, President Lee, in his Liberation Day commemorative speech on the 15th, proposed a multilateral dialogue to discuss ending the war, saying, "Let us set aside mutual intentions to threaten each other and begin discussions among the parties to end the old war." U.S. President Donald Trump also stated on the 16th (local time) via his social media platform Truth Social that he had ordered Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to significantly reduce the scale of the Korea-U.S. joint military exercises, leaving open the possibility of dialogue with North Korea. Accordingly, President Lee is expected to ask for China's role in transitioning to a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula during his talks with Minister Wang. (특히 이 대통령은 지난 15일 광복절 경축사에서 “서로에 대한 상호 위협 의사를 내려놓고, 오래된 전쟁을 끝내기 위한 당사자들 간의 논의를 시작하자”며 종전 논의를 위한 다자 대화를 제안한 바 있다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령도 지난 16일(현지시각) 한-미 연합훈련 규모를 대폭 축소할 것을 피트 헤그세스 국방장관에게 지시했다고 소셜미디어 트루스소셜을 통해 밝히며 북한과의 대화 가능성을 열어뒀다. 그런 만큼 이 대통령은 왕 부장과의 회담에서 한반도 평화체제 전환을 위해 중국의 역할을 당부할 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: "People Power Party's level is deplorable for not recognizing independence activists' taegukgi" (“독립운동가 태극기도 못 알아보는 국힘 수준 참담”)
item.description:
Park Min-young and Son Su-jo, media spokespersons for the People Power Party (PPP), claimed that the taegukgi flags hung at the government-hosted Liberation Day ceremony had incorrect orientations, accusing the government of "insulting the national flag" and of "plotting insurrection to overthrow the state." However, when it became known that these were taegukgi flags used by the provisional government and the Korean Liberation Army before standardization—featuring different taegeuk orientations and arrangements of the four trigrams—the Democratic Party criticized, saying, "The PPP's level, unable to even recognize the taegukgi, is deplorable." <<> Rep. Jeon Yong-gi, the Democratic Party's senior deputy chief of staff for parliamentary communications, said at the party's floor strategy meeting on the 18th, "The taegukgi flags that the PPP spokespersons attacked as if they were evidence of insurrection were, in fact, historic taegukgi flags actually used by righteous armies, the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea, Kim Gu, and the Korean Liberation Army. Some of them are reportedly designated national treasures and registered cultural heritage." He made these remarks in that context. <<> Rep. Jeon said, "It is already shameful not to recognize the taegukgi cherished by the patriots who risked their lives to reclaim the nation, but to attack them as codes of anti-state forces or insurrection without even verifying the facts is worse." He added, "If they are spokespersons of a major party, they should be ashamed of themselves for failing to recognize the taegukgi defended by independence activists and instead focusing solely on incitement." He then urged the PPP, saying, "Apologize to the public for the absurd reckless remarks of your spokespersons and hold them clearly accountable." <<> The Progressive Party also stated, "The PPP should immediately dismiss these people, who are completely unqualified as spokespersons and are solely fixated on stirring up the world with fake news." Hong Seong-gyu, a spokesperson for the Progressive Party, said in a briefing that day, "Excessive ignorance invites disaster beyond control," and criticized, "In front of these taegukgi flags that move anyone to solemn reverence, the PPP spewed reckless remarks unfit to even utter, calling them 'new codes shared among anti-state forces' or 'insurrection plotting to overthrow the state.'" <<> Hong added, "Is the real identity of the PPP's media spokesperson team a 'fake news distribution unit'?" and pointed out, "They should immediately take down the posts and issue an apology, yet these shameless individuals still have the posts up at this very moment." <<> Earlier, on the 15th, Rep. Park posted on Facebook a captured screen of the government-hosted Liberation Day ceremony broadcast, claiming, "The Lee Jae-myung government has gone so far as to hang the taegukgi upside down even at the August 15 event," and "It's bizarre that five flags are displayed in different directions, but not a single one is hung straight." She also said, "At this point, it seems like they're struggling to make it known that they are deliberately insulting the national flag—perhaps it's some new code shared among anti-state forces." That same day, Rep. Son also wrote on Facebook, "Today again, Lee Jae-myung hung the taegukgi upside down at the August 15 Liberation Day ceremony. This is deliberate. This is insurrection plotting to overthrow the state." <<> Contrary to their claims, all taegukgi flags at the Liberation Day ceremony were hung properly. From left, the five flags were: △the Bulwonbok Taegukgi △the Taegukgi of the Provisional Assembly of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea △the current Taegukgi △the Taegukgi with Kim Gu's signature △the Korean Liberation Army signed Taegukgi. Because the taegeuk orientation and the arrangement of the four trigrams were only standardized to their current form in 1949, the designs of these flags differ from the current taegukgi. For example, when the Provisional Assembly Taegukgi is displayed horizontally, the taegeuk is split horizontally rather than vertically, unlike the current flag. The Ministry of the Interior and Safety explained that the "vertical hoisting" method also complied with Article 14 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the National Flag, which stipulates that "the Li trigram should be placed at the upper left." However, in some flags, the arrangement of trigrams differs from the current one, with the Gon trigram placed at the upper left. <<> The Bulwonbok Taegukgi was used by Go Gwang-sun, a righteous army commander during the Korean Empire, and is distinctive for bearing the phrase "Bulwonbok" (不遠復), meaning "recovery of sovereignty in the near future." The Provisional Assembly Taegukgi is said to have been hung at meetings and events of the provisional government and the Provisional Assembly. On the occasion of the March 1 Independence Movement Day this year, the National Assembly also hung a large banner on the front exterior wall of the National Assembly building featuring the image of the Provisional Assembly Taegukgi. Both are currently registered cultural heritage items. The Taegukgi with Kim Gu's signature is a flag Kim Gu sent to a Belgian priest in 1941, while serving as chairman of the provisional government, with a message conveying his will for independence. In the signed message, Kim Gu appealed for help for the Korean Liberation Army so that Koreans could escape the sorrow of national ruin and enjoy freedom and happiness. This flag has been recognized for its historical value and designated as Treasure No. 2141. The Korean Liberation Army signed Taegukgi bears the signatures of Moon Ung-myeong, who served in the Liberation Army, along with about 70 comrades. It is also a registered cultural heritage item. <<> Jeon Gwang-jun Reporter light@hani.co.kr (박민영·손수조 국민의힘 미디어대변인이 정부 주최 광복절 경축식에 걸린 태극기 방향 등이 잘못됐다며 “국기를 능멸했다”, “국가전복을 획책하는 내란”이라고 주장했지만 표준화 이전 임시정부와 한국광복군 등에서 사용한 태극기라 태극 방향과 4괘 배치가 다른 사실이 알려지자 더불어민주당은 “태극기도 못 알아보는 국민의힘 수준이 참담하다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: People Power Party on Democratic Party Convention Result: "A Second-Year President Effectively Defeated" (국힘, 민주 전대 결과에 “2년차 대통령이 사실상 패배”)
item.description:
<<>> The People Power Party evaluated on the 18th that, regarding Kim Min-seok's election as party leader at the Democratic Party of Korea's national convention, "While a foundation for integrating the party and government was created, the pro-Lee (pro-Lee Jae-myung) faction did not completely take control of the party." <<> Kim Seung-su, Deputy Chief of the Floor Leadership for Operations, presided over a floor strategy meeting at the National Assembly that day and said, "In the 'Myeong-Cheong battle,' a president in his second year of term was effectively defeated. Although the president openly intervened to help, Representative Kim struggled in all regions except Honam, and all three pro-Jeong (pro-Jeong Cheong-rae) candidates entered the Supreme Council" and added, "They also failed to oust the forces they had disparaged with the derogatory term 'Mun-jo-teol-rae-yu' (referring to former President Moon Jae-in, former Rep. Cho Kuk of the Rebuilding Korea Party, Kim Eo-jun, former Rep. Jeong Cheong-rae, and author Yoo Si-min), and failed to seize control of the party." This highlights that although pro-Lee candidate Kim won, Jeong Cheong-rae received 45% of the vote, and three pro-Jeong candidates were elected to the five-member Supreme Council. <<> Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook also said on Facebook the previous day, "The president made desperate efforts to prevent an immediate lame duck situation and succeeded in seating Kim Min-seok as party leader" and "The serious internal strife that emerged during the convention will move to Supreme Council meetings, where an even fiercer second round will unfold. It won't be easy for the president to sleep with his legs stretched out." <<> Fourth-term lawmaker Yoo Eui-dong said on KBS radio that day, "In terms of substantive content, the assessment that the pro-Lee faction lost will likely be the dominant view within the party as well" and predicted, "Given the speed and trajectory of the president's approval rating decline, the party leadership will also become quite cautious." Third-term lawmaker Seong Il-jong said, "As the Jeong Cheong-rae faction has also shown itself to be a very strong force in this convention, isn't this the real beginning of division within the ruling party?" and added, "The president's grip on the ruling party may strengthen and create unity, but in the long run, that could be a sign of the party's downfall." <<> Former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min wrote on Facebook, referencing the Supreme Council election results, "This foreshadows that the party-presidential office relationship will be anything but smooth going forward" and "The possibility of the president and the Democratic Party reflecting on policy failures and moving toward governmental reform seems slim. At times like this, shouldn't the People Power Party rebuild conservatism through integration and innovation and offer hope to the people?" <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr ()

item.title: Examining Trump's Claim of 'Massive Burden' of Korea-US Joint Exercises...US Strategic Asset Deployment Costs 80% (트럼프 ‘한미 연합훈련 막대한 부담’ 따져보니…미 전략자산 전개 비용이 80%)
item.description:
US President Donald Trump said on the 16th (local time) that the South Korea-US joint exercises are costly and send a hostile signal to North Korea, and ordered that "since it's too late to cancel, they should be drastically reduced." (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 지난 16일(현지시각) 한-미 연합훈련이 막대한 비용이 들고 북한에 적대적인 신호를 보낸다고 주장하며 “취소하기에는 너무 늦은 만큼 대폭 축소하라”고 지시했다고 밝혔다.)

President Trump said, "These exercises are not only costly, but a large portion of that cost is (as usual) borne by the United States," adding, "They send a totally inappropriate and hostile signal to a country (North Korea) that has not been threatening and has shown a respectful attitude while Donald Trump is president." (트럼프 대통령은 “이 훈련들은 비용이 많이 들 뿐만 아니라, 그 비용의 상당 부분을 (늘 그렇듯이) 미국이 부담하고 있다”며 “도널드 트럼프가 대통령으로 있는 동안 위협적이지 않았고 존중하는 태도를 보여 온 나라(북한)에 전적으로 부적절하고 적대적인 신호를 보내고 있다”고 주장했다.)

Although President Trump complains about paying a large share of the exercise costs, the principle has always been that each country bears its own costs for joint exercises. South Korea and the United States each cover the expenses incurred by their own troops and equipment. (트럼프 대통령은 훈련 비용의 상당 부분을 낸다고 문제삼지만, 원래 연합훈련에 자국이 드는 비용은 자국 부담이 원칙이다. 한국과 미국이 각각 자국 병력과 장비에 소요되는 비용을 낸다.)

According to military officials, the annual cost of South Korea-US joint exercises is not fixed but varies depending on the nature and scope of the training. If only battalion-level tactical unit US troops and equipment are mobilized, the cost is not large, but when US strategic weapons are deployed, the overall exercise cost rises significantly. In this year's South Korea-US joint exercise 'Ulchi Freedom Shield' (UFS), there are 14 battalion-level or larger field maneuver trainings. (군 관계자들의 말을 들어보면, 연간 한-미 연합훈련에 드는 비용 규모는 고정된 것이 아니라 훈련 성격과 내용에 따라 달라진다. 대대급 전술 부대 수준의 미군 병력과 장비만 동원되면 비용은 크지 않고, 미국의 전략무기가 출동하면 전체 훈련 비용이 크게 올라간다. 이번 한-미 연합훈련 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS)에서 대대급 이상 야외기동훈련은 14건이다.)

The South Korean and US military authorities do not separately calculate or disclose costs per exercise. In recent years, the cost of bilateral joint exercises is estimated at roughly 80 billion to 90 billion won annually, with the US military paying around 70 billion won and the South Korean military bearing around 20 billion won per year. (한미 군 당국은 훈련별 비용을 따로 집계·공개하지 않는다. 최근 몇년간 양국 연합훈련에 투입된 비용은 어림잡아 연간 800억~900억원 가량으로 추산되는데, 대략 미군이 700억원 안팎을 내고 한국군이 연간 200억원 안팎을 부담한다고 한다.)

The reason the training costs differ between the South Korean and US militaries is due to their different cost structures. In this exercise, about 18,000 South Korean troops and 5,000 US troops are participating. The South Korean troops in the joint exercise are not reinforcements or mobilized reservists but existing active-duty personnel, and since they use existing equipment already in the country, only additional costs such as fuel and spare parts arise, keeping training costs low. The US calculation items are much more complex. There are reservists called up among the training forces, and significant budget is spent moving reinforcement forces from the mainland, Guam, Japan, and other overseas bases to the Korean Peninsula. (한국군과 미군이 내는 훈련 비용이 다른 것은 양국 군대의 비용구조가 다르기 때문이다. 이번 훈련에 한국군은 약 1만8천여명이 참가하고 미군은 5천명이 참가한다. 연합훈련에 참여하는 한국군은 증원되거나 동원되는 병력이 아니라 기존에 있는 현역 병력이고 국내에 있는 기존 장비를 훈련에 투입해 장비 기름값, 수리부속비 등이 추가되므로 훈련 비용이 크지 않다. 미군의 계산 항목은 훨씬 복잡하다. 훈련 병력 중 소집된 예비군들이 있고, 본토와 괌·일본 등 역외 기지에서 증원 전력을 한반도로 옮기느라 예산이 많이 든다.)

Basic cost items in the exercise include personnel costs for mobilized troops, transportation, uniforms, rations, medical supplies, equipment fuel, and spare parts. (훈련 비용 가운데 기본 항목은 동원 병력의 인건비, 수송비, 피복비, 부식비, 의료용품, 장비 기름값, 수리부속비 등이 있다.)

The largest portion of US training costs is not personnel costs but the expenses for moving reinforcements and equipment from the US mainland, Guam, or Japan to the Korean Peninsula. In particular, deploying a carrier strike group, considered a strategic asset, costs about 10 billion won per deployment, a B-2 stealth bomber sortie costs about 6 billion won, B-1B bomber deployment costs about 2 to 4 billion won, and a stealth fighter (F-35, F-22) sortie costs 100 million to 200 million won. It is said that among the US-bearerd training costs, excluding personnel costs, expenses for mobilizing US strategic weapons account for over 80% of the total budget. (미국 훈련 비용에서 큰 비중을 차지하는 것은 인건비가 아니라 미 본토나 괌, 일본에서 한반도로 증원되는 병력과 장비에 드는 비용이다. 특히 전략자산으로 꼽히는 항모전단 1회 전개에 약 100억원, B-2 스텔스폭격기 1회 출격에 약 60억원, B-1B 폭격기 전개에는 약 20억~40억원, 스텔스 전투기(F-35, F-22) 1회 출동 비용이 1억~2억원이 든다고 한다. 미국이 부담하는 훈련 비용 중 인건비를 뺀 전체 예산 중 미국 전략무기 동원에 소요되는 비용이 80% 이상이라고 한다.)

Because deploying strategic weapons is expensive for the US, when aircraft carriers or strategic bombers are dispatched, they often conduct not only South Korea-US exercises but also US-Japan exercises or trilateral South Korea-US-Japan exercises while in the region. (미국은 전략무기 전개에 큰 돈이 들기 때문에 항공모함이나 전략폭격기는 출동하면 한-미 훈련만 하는게 아니라 온 김에 미-일 훈련이나 한·미·일 연합훈련도 하는 경우가 잦다.)

Kwon Hyuk-chul Reporter nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)
